grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: A Busy Week at the Community Library
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文是关于社区图书馆志愿者工作的模拟材料。请根据短文内容选择正确答案或填空。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
passage:
A. Lin Mei is a volunteer at a small community library. She works there three days a week: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. She starts at nine in the morning and finishes at four in the afternoon. She has to open the library and turn on the computers. She must check the return box every morning. She can take a short break at noon, but she cannot leave the building.

B. Last week was very busy. On Monday, many students came to study for exams. Lin Mei helped them find books and use the printers. She had to stay thirty minutes late because a student needed help with a computer. On Wednesday, a children's story time happened at ten o'clock. Lin Mei read a story to twelve children. She must speak slowly and clearly when she reads. The children liked the story very much. On Friday, the library received fifty new books. Lin Mei and another volunteer, Mr. Chen, put the books on the shelves. They had to work quickly because the library opened at nine. They finished at ten thirty.

C. This week, Lin Mei has a new duty. She must train a new volunteer, Wang Fang, on Tuesday. Wang Fang can speak English and Chinese. She has to learn how to use the library computer system. Lin Mei will show her the steps. Lin Mei says, "You must always be friendly to people. You can ask me questions anytime." Wang Fang is a little nervous, but she is ready to learn. Lin Mei is happy to help because she likes teaching new volunteers.

questions.prompt: Lin Mei works at the library on which days?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段明确说：She works there three days a week: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. 因此选“Monday, Wednesday, and Friday”。
questions.evidence: She works there three days a week: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

questions.prompt: What time does Lin Mei start work in the morning?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说：She starts at nine in the morning. 所以开始时间是九点。
questions.evidence: She starts at nine in the morning and finishes at four in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: What must Lin Mei check every morning?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说：She must check the return box every morning. 因此她必须检查还书箱。
questions.evidence: She must check the return box every morning.

questions.prompt: Why did Lin Mei stay late on Monday?
options: A student needed help with a computer.
She had to clean the library.
answers: A student needed help with a computer.
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说：She had to stay thirty minutes late because a student needed help with a computer. 因此她晚走是因为一个学生需要电脑帮助。
questions.evidence: She had to stay thirty minutes late because a student needed help with a computer.

questions.prompt: How many children came to the story time on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说：Lin Mei read a story to twelve children. 所以有十二个孩子来听故事。
questions.evidence: Lin Mei read a story to twelve children.

questions.prompt: What did Lin Mei and Mr. Chen do on Friday?
options: They put new books on the shelves.
They read a story to children.
answers: They put new books on the shelves.
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说：Lin Mei and another volunteer, Mr. Chen, put the books on the shelves. 因此他们在周五把新书放到书架上。
questions.evidence: Lin Mei and another volunteer, Mr. Chen, put the books on the shelves.

questions.prompt: What is Lin Mei's new duty this week?
options: She must train a new volunteer.
answers: She must train a new volunteer.
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说：This week, Lin Mei has a new duty. She must train a new volunteer, Wang Fang, on Tuesday. 因此她的新职责是培训新志愿者。
questions.evidence: She must train a new volunteer, Wang Fang, on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: What languages can Wang Fang speak? (Use two words from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说：Wang Fang can speak English and Chinese. 因此她会说英语和中文。
questions.evidence: Wang Fang can speak English and Chinese.

questions.prompt: What must Lin Mei always do when she reads a story to children?
options: She must speak slowly and clearly.
answers: She must speak slowly and clearly.
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说：She must speak slowly and clearly when she reads. 因此她读故事时必须缓慢清晰地说话。
questions.evidence: She must speak slowly and clearly when she reads.

questions.prompt: How does Lin Mei feel about helping Wang Fang?
options: She is too busy to help.
She does not want to help.
questions.explanation: 短文第三段最后一句说：Lin Mei is happy to help because she likes teaching new volunteers. 因此她乐于帮助。
questions.evidence: Lin Mei is happy to help because she likes teaching new volunteers.

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用 have to 和 must 表示“必须”，用 can 表示“能够”或“可以”。have to 强调客观需要，must 强调主观义务，can 表示能力或许可。一般现在时描述经常发生的事，一般过去时描述过去发生的事。例如：She has to open the library.（现在经常） She had to stay late.（过去一次）。
grammar.example: She has to open the library and turn on the computers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a present obligation.
options: She has to wear a uniform at work.
She had to wear a uniform yesterday.
answers: She has to wear a uniform at work.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时表示现在的义务，用 has to + 动词原形。选项A正确。
questions.evidence: She has to open the library and turn on the computers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past obligation.
options: He must finish the report last night.
He had to finish the report last night.
He has to finish the report last night.
He can finish the report last night.
answers: He had to finish the report last night.
questions.explanation: 过去时表示过去的义务，用 had to + 动词原形。选项B正确。
questions.evidence: She had to stay thirty minutes late because a student needed help with a computer.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about ability.
questions.explanation: can 表示能力，后面接动词原形。选项A正确。
questions.evidence: Wang Fang can speak English and Chinese.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a present habit.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常性动作，主语They后动词用原形。选项A正确。
questions.evidence: She works there three days a week: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
